description: Fetch Gate exchange deposit address for the session-bound Gate UID. [write] amount must be ≥ min_deposit_amount; do not pass uid — it is resolved from the session.

amount.description: Required. Human-readable amount (same units as on-chain transfer); must be ≥ exchange min_deposit_amount

mcp_token.description: MCP session token obtained from login (dex_auth_google_login_poll or dex_auth_gate_login_poll). MUST be provided in every call to this tool after login; omitting it will result in 403

token_address.description: Optional. ERC20 contract for gate-deposit; empty for native. If omitted, USDT is resolved from chain_name; other symbols may require this field

name: dex_withdraw_deposit_address
